description: The chart illustrates the distribution of attention across different categories for two models, "Ours" and "Standard", with the categories being "Context", "Generated Response", and "Other". The vertical axis represents the model names and contains two categories, "Ours" and "Standard", listed in a specific order. The horizontal axis represents the percentage distribution, ranging from 0% to 100%, with the bars being stacked to show the proportion of each category. The chart uses a color-coded legend to differentiate between the categories, with "Context" represented in blue, "Generated Response" in orange, and "Other" in green. For the "Ours" model, the "Context" category accounts for approximately 60.6%, "Generated Response" for 31.7%, and "Other" for 7.7%, while for the "Standard" model, the distribution is 23.6% for "Context", 51.1% for "Generated Response", and 25.3% for "Other". The bars are not sorted in a specific order other than by model name, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
